name: 3FX Mixer
tagline: Studio-Grade Web Audio DSP & Mixer for Google Chrome
description: Professional-grade audio mixer for browser tabs with real-time effects, 8-band dynamic EQ, vintage tape saturation, studio compressor, reverb, texturizer, and spatializer.

dspModules.name: 8-Band Dynamic EQ
dspModules.description: Parametric equalizer with peak, shelf, and notch filters and interactive canvas visualization.

dspModules.name: Vintage Tape Machine
dspModules.description: Analog tape saturation, warmth, wow/flutter, and tape speed controls.

dspModules.name: Studio Compressor
dspModules.description: Downwards and upwards compression with knee curve, sidechain filter, and gain reduction meter.

dspModules.name: Stereo & Slowed Reverb
dspModules.description: High-fidelity impulse response convolution and algorithmic decay engine.

dspModules.name: Texturizer & Bitcrusher
dspModules.description: Sample rate decimation, bit reduction, and vinyl/cassette ambient background generator.

dspModules.name: Stereo Imager & Spatializer
dspModules.description: Haas effect stereo widener, mid-side processing, and 3D binaural positioning.

dspModules.name: Sub-Bass Enhancer
dspModules.description: Tuned harmonic bass generator and sub-octave synthesizer.

dspModules.name: True Peak Limiter
dspModules.description: Transparent brickwall lookahead peak limiter to eliminate digital clipping.

author: 3FX Audio Labs
